title: Integral lattice subquotients of a lisse extension by zero
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes $S,X$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Coefficient ring sheaves $E_T,\mathcal O_{E,T}$ are pulled back condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and module sheaves are those of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ be a locally closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and let $L$ be an $E_S$-module locally free of finite rank for the pro-étale topology, with rank allowed to vary. Use exact locally closed extension by zero $a_!$ of $E$-modules [sk-lem-coefficient-heart]; for the $\mathcal O_E$-module objects $L_{0,b}$, $a_{b!}$ is the extension by zero of module objects of [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. There exist a finite locally closed stratification $S=\coprod_{b=1}^mS_b$ [def-constructible-stratification], lisse finite free $\mathcal O_{E,S_b}$-submodules $L_{0,b}\subseteq L|_{S_b}$ with $L_{0,b}[1/\ell]\cong L|_{S_b}$, and a finite filtration by $E_X$-submodule sheaves
$$0=F_0\subseteq F_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq F_m=a_!L,$$
such that, writing $a_b:S_b\hookrightarrow X$ for the composite immersion, each quotient has an isomorphism
$$F_b/F_{b-1}\cong E_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}a_{b!}L_{0,b}.$$
Here $M[1/\ell]=E_T\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,T}}M$ [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. The unions $S_1\cup\cdots\cup S_b$ may be chosen open in $S$. Empty strata and zero subquotients are allowed.

source.place: Proof (1): choose stratified lattices, order the strata, push the sheaf filtration through a_!, and identify the rationalized integral subquotients

proof.text: Both $S$ and $X$ are Noetherian: a field is Noetherian (its only ideals are zero and the whole field), so [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] gives local Noetherianity, and finite type gives quasi-compactness. Apply [sk-lem-stratified-lattice] to the given lisse $E_S$-module. Obtain a finite locally closed partition $S=\coprod_iT_i$ with lisse $\mathcal O_{E,T_i}$-submodules $M_i\subseteq L|_{T_i}$ and $M_i[1/\ell]\cong L|_{T_i}$. This theorem allows varying ranks and does not require a global lattice.

For every scheme $T$ write $Q_T(M)=E_T\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,T}}M$. By [lem-sfb-continuous-ring-universe-realization], applied to the totally disconnected rings $\mathcal O_E$ and $E$, the pulled-back coefficient rings $\mathcal O_{E,T}=p_T^*\underline{\mathcal O}_E$ and $E_T=p_T^*\underline E$ are canonically and multiplicatively identified with the continuous-function ring sheaves $V\mapsto C(|V|,\mathcal O_E)$ and $V\mapsto C(|V|,E)$. The comparison is built from the inverse-image adjunction and the profinite test projection, so it is natural in the topological ring and carries $p_T^*$ of the inclusion $\underline{\mathcal O}_E\to\underline E$ to postcomposition with $\mathcal O_E\subset E$. That postcomposition is the continuous integral-to-field coefficient inclusion of [lem-sfb-integral-rationalization-exact], so $Q_T$ is exact on arbitrary module sheaves. Derived coefficient change is $LQ_T$ by [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change]. The exact-functor clause of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] therefore identifies $LQ_T$ with termwise $Q_T$. In particular $E_T\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,T}}M[0]\cong Q_T(M)[0]$ for every module sheaf $M$, including extensions by zero which need not be lisse on $T$.

Apply [det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification](1) on the Noetherian scheme $S$, with $\Lambda=E$, to refine the partition $\{T_i\}$ into $S_1,\ldots,S_m$ with $U_b=\bigcup_{c\le b}S_c$ open in $S$. For each refinement immersion $h:S_b\hookrightarrow T_i$, put $L_{0,b}=h^*M_i$. By [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients], inverse image is exact for both coefficient systems and identifies their rings; thus it preserves the lattice inclusion and carries each local free basis to a local free basis of the same rank. Clause (1) of [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback], specialized to $\mathcal O_E\to E$ and the degree-zero $M_i$, together with Step 2, gives $Q_{S_b}(L_{0,b})\cong h^*Q_{T_i}(M_i)\cong L|_{S_b}$. Hence these restricted submodules are the required lattices on the ordered refinement.

source.place: (1), ordered refinement and restriction of the chosen lattices

proof.text: The lisse sheaf $L$ is constructible by the characterization in [sk-lem-coefficient-heart]. Every restriction to the chosen strata is lisse, so this ordered stratification is adapted to $L$. Apply [det-lem-coefficient-heart-filtration] on $S$. With $v_b:U_b\hookrightarrow S$ and $t_b:S_b\hookrightarrow S$, it gives $G_b=v_{b!}v_b^*L\subseteq L$, endpoints $G_0=0$, $G_m=L$, and short exact sequences $0\to G_{b-1}\to G_b\to t_{b!}(L|_{S_b})\to0$.

source.place: (1), filtration of L on its ordered stratification

proof.text: Set $F_b=a_!G_b$. Exactness of locally closed extension in [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence], applied to $R=E_X$, preserves the inclusions and the short exact sequences of Step 4. Its composition isomorphism identifies $a_!t_{b!}$ with $a_{b!}$, so $F_0=0$, $F_m=a_!L$ and $F_b/F_{b-1}\cong a_{b!}(L|_{S_b})$. All coefficient restrictions are those of [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients]. The composite $a_b$ is locally closed directly from the immersion description [def-weil-closed-immersion]: write $S$ closed in an open $V\subseteq X$ and $S_b$ closed in an open $W\subseteq S$; choose an open $V'\subseteq V$ with $W=S\cap V'$. Then $W$ is closed in $V'$, and $S_b$ is closed there, since the two surjective structure-sheaf maps compose to a surjection.

source.place: (1), pushing the filtration through a_! and composing immersions

proof.text: Apply [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback](2) to $a_b$, $\mathcal O_E\to E$, and $L_{0,b}[0]$. The standing finite-type separated hypotheses hold for $S_b$ and $X$. The extension by zero $a_{b!}$ of that clause is the functor of [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence]. That lemma identifies it with $i_*u_!$ for the factorization $a_b=i\circ u$ through the closure. On $\mathcal O_E$-module objects this is the functor $a_{b!}$ of the statement [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek], whose underlying sheaf is the abelian extension by zero, and on $E$-modules it is the $a_{b!}$ of [sk-lem-coefficient-heart] used in Step 5. Step 2 identifies both derived scalar extensions with ordinary ones, and exact $a_{b!}$ acts termwise. Taking degree-zero cohomology gives an $E_X$-linear isomorphism $Q_X(a_{b!}L_{0,b})\cong a_{b!}Q_{S_b}(L_{0,b})$. Combining this with Step 3 and the quotient identification in Step 5 gives $F_b/F_{b-1}\cong E_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}a_{b!}L_{0,b}$, as asserted. For $S=\varnothing$ take $m=0$; zero ranks or empty strata merely give repeated filtration terms and zero quotients, which are permitted.
